summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi Total U.S. Market 2x Daily ETF (USX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund uses swap agreements and other financial instruments to pursue 2x leveraged exposure to the daily performance of the Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF (VTI), before fees and expenses. The fund does not aim to achieve 2x of the underlying ETF for any period other than a single day. USX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
